data.title: Mayo scissors
data.summary: Scissors · Heavy, robust scissors for cutting thick tissue such as fascia and cartilage.
data.body:
![Mayo scissors](instruments/mayo-scissors.jpg)

Heavy, robust scissors for cutting thick tissue such as fascia and cartilage.

## Parts
- Two blades pivoting on a rivet/screw that acts as fulcrum; ring handles
- Short heavy blades, sturdier than Metzenbaum

## Types / variants
- Straight or curved

## Uses / indications
- Cutting thick tissue (fascia, cartilage)
- Straight Mayo commonly used to cut sutures in general surgery

## How to hold
Tripod grip: thumb and ring finger in the rings (only up to the distal phalanx), index finger resting near the screw joint for stability.

## Sterilisation & care
Autoclave, hot air oven, 2% glutaraldehyde or boiling

## Viva points & tips
- Mayo = short handle, heavy blades; Metzenbaum = long handle, fine blades
